message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors.

Issues:

- Missing Mockito imports: test uses MockitoExtension and @Mock. We can remove Mockito usage entirely, as logger is manually created; the @Mock annotation is not needed. Simplify: remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) and @Mock annotation and related imports.

- StubLogger extends MarkerIgnoringBase which implements Logger but abstract methods need to be overridden: error(String, Throwable) maybe abstract. Actually Logger interface has many methods, MarkerIgnoringBase implements many default methods but some are abstract? Let's check: In SLF4J, MarkerIgnoringBase implements Logger, providing default implementations for methods with Marker, but error(String, Throwable) is defined as abstract? Actually Logger interface has methods: error(String msg); error(String format, Object arg); error(String format, Object arg1, Object arg2); error(String format, Object... arguments); error(String msg, Throwable t). MarkerIgnoringBase implements all with default empty bodies except maybe error(String, Throwable) is abstract? Let's check quickly: In slf4j, MarkerIgnoringBase implements Logger and provides default implementations for all methods that accept Marker, but for methods without Marker, it provides abstract methods? I recall that MarkerIgnoringBase implements Logger and provides concrete implementations for all methods except those that accept a Throwable? Actually I think it implements all methods: each method calls log(...). Wait need to verify.

But compile error says StubLogger does not override abstract method error(String,Throwable) in Logger. So MarkerIgnoringBase does not implement that method; it's abstract. So we need to implement error(String, Throwable) in StubLogger.

Add:

@Override
public void error(String msg, Throwable t) {
    /* no-op */
}

Also maybe other abstract methods: error(String) maybe also abstract? But compile error only mentions error(String,Throwable). Let's implement that.

Also need to import org.slf4j.Logger; already there.

Now remove Mockito imports and annotation.

Also the test class uses @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) which we can remove. Also remove import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; and import org.mockito.*; Also remove @Mock annotation line.

But there is a field:

@Mock
Logger // mock logger injected by Mockito
logger;

We can just remove this field entirely, as not used. The test uses its own StubLogger instances. So delete that field.

Now adjust imports: remove unused imports.

Now ensure that BaseJsonValidator.debug method is accessible; it's protected static void debug(Logger, JsonNode, JsonNode, String). Since test is in same package com.networknt.schema, it can access protected static method. Good.

Now compile.

Potential other errors: The test uses assertArrayEquals from JUnit Assertions; need static import of org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.* already there.

The test uses @ParameterizedTest and MethodSource; we need import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest; already there. Also need import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments; and MethodSource; already there.

Now after removing Mockito imports, we need to adjust imports list.

Let's produce corrected code.
